notes.title: Cursed Bet OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Cursed Bet, which I've been working on as a solo developer, is finally out and I'm so excited to share it with you. For now, only English and Turkish languages ​​are available. Let me also inform you that new languages ​​will be added as soon as possible. Go now and meet the cursed doll Ebeleen without wasting any time. Have a nice game... ːsteamhappyː[/h3]
